title: Text: DET Ben Fidelman ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: They have been the home jerseys since 1945
Horrible way to conduct business: not changing things because it’s been done the same way for decades
The new jersey’s will be synonymous with losing for the first five years
“That’s the jersey they went to when the Tigers started sucking again.”
I think Mahtook as our best outfielder will be more connected with losing than the minuscule update to a home jersey
